assumptions: Research accessed 2026-11-14. Two adults and two children aged 4 and 7; one room/condo sleeping four; five nights December 21-26, 2026 versus February 22-27, 2027 for EVERY destination. Lodging and airfare figures are analyst planning ESTIMATES, not live quotes or verified availability; lodging excludes taxes, resort/cleaning/parking fees; airfare is estimated round-trip economy per person with taxes, excluding bags and seat fees. Same named property and room class assumed for both periods; property descriptions are verified but rates are not. Totals use 5*nightly lodging+4*airfare and exclude meals, local transport and activities. Airports are practical commercial gateways, not always geographically closest airports; flights are published generic nonstop durations, rounded to decimal hours, not exact-date schedule confirmation. Drives exclude stops, border delays and winter conditions; all except sourced Santa Fe drive time are estimates. Base elevation is lodging town/resort village, not summit. NOAA white-Christmas percentages use December 25 DLY-SNWD-PCTALL-GE001WI (>=1 inch) 1991-2020 normals; Jackson, Banff and West Yellowstone probabilities are null rather than fabricated. US temperatures use December 25 and February 15 daily normals; Dillon and Fraser are labeled estimated proxies for Breckenridge and Winter Park. West Yellowstone temperatures use 1981-2010 normals, tenths F converted to F. Banff temperatures are estimated from available Banff CS daily observations within 1991-2020. Snow depths are ESTIMATED local climatology from means of available GHCN SNWD observations for December 21-26 and February 12-18 within 1991-2020, excluding missing values, nonblank quality flags and measurement flag P (missing presumed zero), mm/25.4; gaps and exclusion of presumed zeros can bias estimates. These are snow-on-ground depths, not snowfall, not guaranteed hotel-yard depths. West Yellowstone depths are null due sparse recent coverage. Banff uses CAN03050519; other station IDs appear in sources. Crowds are qualitative estimates. Activity prices are per child unless note specifies vehicle or adult/rider; posted rates may be older seasons and are not exact-date quotes. Estimated activity numbers are identified in notes and via kid_activities in estimated_fields. Canadian activity conversions assume estimated USD0.72/CAD, before tax; no live FX quote. No purchases, approvals or outside writes.

destinations.name: Steamboat Springs

kid_activities.name: Saddleback Ranch Yee-Haw tubing
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; age 4 and under share an adult's tube.
kid_activities.note: Posted two-hour drive-yourself price per rider age 5+; age 4 and under free with an adult. Shuttle variant is $56.18 age 5+ and $5.30 age 4 and under. Snow dependent; some low-season weekday closures.

kid_activities.name: Old Town Hot Springs swimming
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: Child rate ages 3-14; adult supervision required.
kid_activities.note: Per child daily admission; adults $35. Closed December 25. Choose the swimming facilities appropriate to the child's age; hot soaking pools and water slides have separate rules.

kid_activities.name: Yampa River Core Trail winter nature stroll
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; accompanied children.
kid_activities.note: Estimated zero admission for a short public-trail outing; icy surfaces and snow cover vary. Look for tracks and snowy river views; no equipment included.

destinations.nature_highlight: Snow-covered Yampa Valley, forested Mount Werner and a river running through town.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Tubing with a parent, snow play and a warm swimming break create an easy rhythm without buying ski lift tickets.
destinations.risks: Altitude at 6,695 feet; very cold mornings; US-40 storm delays; holiday sell-outs and possible minimum stays. HDN nonstop schedules require exact-date confirmation. February 1-6 overlaps Winter Carnival, so comparison uses February 22-27. Lodging model: Holiday Inn standard two-queen room, same class both weeks.

destinations.name: Banff

kid_activities.name: Mount Norquay tubing
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: At least age 4 AND at least 42 inches tall.
kid_activities.note: Estimated USD conversion of posted child starting rate CAD32 at assumed USD0.72/CAD. Adults start at CAD52, approximately USD37.44. Rates vary by session; taxes extra. A smaller four-year-old may not qualify.

kid_activities.name: Banff public horse-drawn sleigh ride
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; child ticket ages 4-12; under 18 accompanied.
kid_activities.note: Estimated USD conversion of posted child starting price CAD42.83 at USD0.72/CAD. Adult CAD54.41 approximately USD39.18. Christmas peak surcharges not verified; wagon substitution if snow is insufficient.

kid_activities.name: Bow Falls viewpoint and snow play
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; adult supervision.
kid_activities.note: Estimated zero attraction admission; national park admission, parking and any traction equipment are additional. Use maintained viewpoints; icy riverbanks are unsuitable for play.

destinations.nature_highlight: The Bow Valley's immense Canadian Rockies, with snowy peaks surrounding the town and nearby frozen-water scenery.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: A real horse-drawn ride, towering mountains and short snowy walks are impressive without sustained hiking.
destinations.risks: Cold snaps and icy Trans-Canada Highway; passports and international travel requirements; crowded Christmas lodging and minimum stays. Lake Louise requires an additional excursion; frozen lakes are not automatically safe to walk on. Base elevation is town, not ski areas. Lodging model: Banff Park Lodge superior two-queen room.

destinations.name: Jackson / Grand Teton

kid_activities.name: National Elk Refuge sleigh ride
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; child rate ages 5-12; age 4 and under free.
kid_activities.note: 2026-27 published child rate; adults $43. Closed Christmas Day; season December 19-April 3, conditions permitting. Bring your own blankets; none provided.

kid_activities.name: Astoria Hot Springs children's pool
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; child rate ages 2-12; adult supervision.
kid_activities.note: Posted nonresident child admission; adult $26.25. Children's pool is cooler than soaking pools. Closed Wednesdays; book a timed session.

kid_activities.name: Grand Teton scenic viewpoints and short snow walk
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum for self-guided outing; adult supervision.
kid_activities.note: Price is a seven-day private-vehicle park pass covering the family, not per child. Use open roads and designated viewpoints. Ranger snowshoe hikes currently require age 8+, so are excluded for this family.

destinations.nature_highlight: The abrupt, jagged Teton Range above an elk-filled winter valley.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Elk viewed from a sleigh provide a wildlife memory even if the children never learn to ski.
destinations.risks: Cold, altitude and flight disruption; Teton Park Road has winter vehicle closures and park visitor centers close. Holiday room sell-outs and minimum stays possible. Do not plan to drive through Yellowstone's south entrance in winter. Lodging model: Mountain Modern two-queen room in Jackson, not Teton Village.

destinations.name: Winter Park

kid_activities.name: Hideaway Park sledding
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; parental supervision recommended.
kid_activities.note: Tourism site confirms free hill and shared sleds. Downtown option; weather dependent.

kid_activities.name: Coca-Cola Tube Hill
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: At least 36 inches tall; every rider uses their own tube.
kid_activities.note: Price varies in booking system; no current date-specific amount verified. Independent tubes make this less suitable for a timid child than parent-and-child tubing.

kid_activities.name: Village ice skating
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; confirm rental size for youngest child.
kid_activities.note: Estimated rental allowance per person per hour, using tourism site's posted $10-$15 range; rink admission listed as free. Seasonal schedule not confirmed for the requested weeks.

destinations.nature_highlight: Snow-laden Fraser Valley forests beneath the Continental Divide.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: Free sleds, a small rink and a conveyor-served tubing hill offer several short activities.
destinations.risks: High sleeping altitude near resort base; Berthoud Pass can close in storms; Denver weekend traffic; holiday sell-outs and minimum stays possible. Temperature fields use lower Fraser station as an estimated local proxy. Snow station is Winter Park, above some downtown lodging. Lodging model: Vintage Hotel two-queen room.

destinations.name: Breckenridge

kid_activities.name: Carter Park sledding
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; parent supervision.
kid_activities.note: Free hill and community sled shed; winter reopening and snow conditions determine operation. Walk uphill; no conveyor.

kid_activities.name: Grand Colorado Peak 8 skating
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: Child price ages 12 and under; no minimum published.
kid_activities.note: Published 2025-26 child price includes admission and skate rental for one hour; adults $21. Future-week price not confirmed.

kid_activities.name: BreckConnect gondola ride
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; children accompanied.
kid_activities.note: Resort confirms free transportation gondola, no ticket needed. This is not a summit lift ticket. Wind or operational closures possible.

destinations.nature_highlight: The Tenmile Range rising directly above a historic snowy mountain town.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: A free gondola cabin ride and old-fashioned sledding deliver mountain excitement with little need for skiing.
destinations.risks: Highest sleeping elevation among these choices; cold and wind; I-70 delays or closures; Christmas sell-outs and minimum stays. February still attracts ski crowds. Temperatures use Dillon 1 E as an estimated lower-elevation proxy, not a Breckenridge normal. Lodging model: Beaver Run one-bedroom condo with bedroom and sleeper sofa.

destinations.name: West Yellowstone

kid_activities.name: Grizzly & Wolf Discovery Center
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; child rate ages 5-12; age 4 and under free.
kid_activities.note: Posted admission; adults $17.50. Good for two consecutive days; open every day including holidays. Captive rescue/education animals, not guaranteed wild sightings.

kid_activities.name: Yellowstone Expeditions Old Faithful snowcoach
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: Child age cutoff and car-seat rules not published in opened rate sheet; verify suitability before purchase.
kid_activities.note: 2026-27 published child fare; adult $190. Full-day trip with heated coach. Local tax and adult park fees extra. Long day for age 4; request child restraint arrangements.

kid_activities.name: Boundary Trail short snowshoe outing
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; adult supervision.
kid_activities.note: Tourism site confirms free access and gentle terrain; equipment rental extra and unverified. Do a short out-and-back rather than the full trail.

destinations.nature_highlight: Steaming Yellowstone geysers amid snow and frost-covered forest.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: A heated snowcoach feels like an expedition, and wolves, bears and otters offer a second wildlife day close to lodging.
destinations.risks: Severe cold and altitude; snowy Gallatin Canyon transfer; most Yellowstone roads closed to private cars. WYS is not assumed to offer winter service; use BZN. Nonstop service may not run on both exact travel dates. Limited winter lodging, snowcoach sell-outs and minimum stays possible. Temperature normals are older 1981-2010; snow-depth evidence too sparse to report. Lodging model: Kelly Inn Canyon Building two-queen room, open year-round.

destinations.name: Tahoe City / North Lake Tahoe

kid_activities.name: Tahoe City Winter Sports Park sledding
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum stated; age 3 and younger free with paying adult.
kid_activities.note: Posted nonresident price per person, 90-minute session including disc. Page labels rates 2025-26, so 2026-27 rate not confirmed. Depends on natural snow.

kid_activities.name: Tahoe City Winter Sports Park skating
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; confirm skate size; children supervised.
kid_activities.note: Posted nonresident package per person includes skate rental and rink session. Assist device costs $10 extra. Page still labels rates 2025-26.

kid_activities.name: Tahoe City Winter Sports Park snowshoeing
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; confirm children's rental sizes.
kid_activities.note: Posted youth nonresident package includes rental and trail reservation for 90 minutes; adult package $25. Page labels rates 2025-26. Snow dependent; keep outing short.

destinations.nature_highlight: Deep blue Lake Tahoe framed by Sierra peaks and snow-covered pines.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: The contrast of blue water and snow, plus gentle sledding and skating, supplies variety without ski-school commitments.
destinations.risks: Lake-level thaws or rain can reduce snow; major Sierra storms can cause road closures and chain controls; holiday lodging sells out and minimum stays may apply. Resort snowpack is not lakefront snowpack. Lodging model: Granlibakken standard two-queen or two-double room, specifically selected for four.

destinations.name: Santa Fe

kid_activities.name: Hyde Memorial State Park sledding
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: No minimum published; adult supervision.
kid_activities.note: Price is nonresident day-use fee per vehicle, not per child, from state parks FAQ. Tourism blog's older $5 figure conflicts; use state's $10. Bring sleds; snow dependent.

kid_activities.name: Ski Santa Fe Chipmunk Corner beginner lesson
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: Age 5-11 full-day skiing; age 4 has separate Little Chips half-day.
kid_activities.note: Posted full-day first-timer package including rentals and lift access; age-4 half-day package is $242. Snowboard minimum age 6. Mountain altitude is substantially above town.

kid_activities.name: Santa Fe Children's Museum
kid_activities.min_age_or_height: All ages; child price, under age 1 free.
kid_activities.note: Posted out-of-state child admission; adult $15. Indoor weather fallback. Closed Mondays, Tuesdays and Christmas Day; reduced Christmas Eve hours.

destinations.nature_highlight: Sangre de Cristo mountain forests above the high-desert adobe city.
destinations.why_memorable_for_ages_4_to_7: A road trip with mountain sledding and a playful indoor fallback avoids making skiing the entire vacation.
destinations.risks: Town snow is unreliable: Santa Fe 2 station has only 9% NOAA Christmas snow-cover probability. Mountain snow is a separate proposition; ski road can be icy or closed. Altitude increases sharply uphill. Driving time excludes stops and winter delays; holiday lodging can sell out or impose minimum stays. ABQ is the practical nonstop gateway; SAF is geographically nearer but usually requires a connection from IAH. Lodging model: Hampton Inn Santa Fe South two-queen room.
